# Zalo OA Channel

[Permalink: Zalo OA Channel](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#zalo-oa-channel)

Zalo Official Account (OA) integration. DM-only with pairing-based access control and image support.

## Setup

[Permalink: Setup](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#setup)

**Create Zalo OA:**

1. Go to [https://oa.zalo.me](https://oa.zalo.me/)
2. Create Official Account (requires Zalo phone number)
3. Set up OA name, avatar, and cover photo
4. In OA settings, go to "Settings" → "API" → "Bot API"
5. Create API key
6. Copy API key for configuration

**Enable Zalo OA:**

```
{
  "channels": {
    "zalo": {
      "enabled": true,
      "token": "YOUR_API_KEY",
      "dm_policy": "pairing",
      "allow_from": [],
      "media_max_mb": 5
    }
  }
}
```

## Configuration

[Permalink: Configuration](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#configuration)

All config keys are in `channels.zalo`:

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | bool | false | Enable/disable channel |
| `token` | string | required | API key from Zalo OA console |
| `allow_from` | list | -- | User ID allowlist |
| `dm_policy` | string | `"pairing"` | `pairing`, `allowlist`, `open`, `disabled` |
| `webhook_url` | string | -- | Optional webhook URL (override polling) |
| `webhook_secret` | string | -- | Optional webhook signature secret |
| `media_max_mb` | int | 5 | Max image file size (MB) |
| `block_reply` | bool | -- | Override gateway block\_reply (nil=inherit) |
| `chat_behavior` | object | -- | Override gateway [human-like delivery](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels-overview#human-like-delivery) for this channel (nil = inherit) |

## Features

[Permalink: Features](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#features)

### DM-Only

[Permalink: DM-Only](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#dm-only)

Zalo OA only supports direct messaging. Group functionality is not available. All messages are treated as DMs.

### Long Polling

[Permalink: Long Polling](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#long-polling)

Default mode: Bot polls Zalo API every 30 seconds for new messages. Server returns messages and marks them read.

- Poll timeout: 30 seconds (default)
- Error backoff: 5 seconds
- Text limit: 2,000 characters per message
- Image limit: 5 MB

### Webhook Mode (Optional)

[Permalink: Webhook Mode (Optional)](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#webhook-mode-optional)

Instead of polling, configure Zalo to POST events to your gateway:

```
{
  "webhook_url": "https://your-gateway.com/zalo/webhook",
  "webhook_secret": "your_webhook_secret"
}
```

Zalo sends a HMAC signature in header `X-Zalo-Signature`. Implementation verifies this before processing.

### Image Support

[Permalink: Image Support](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#image-support)

Bot can receive and send images (JPG, PNG). Max 5 MB by default.

**Receive**: Images are downloaded and stored as temporary files during message processing.

**Send**: Images can be sent as media attachment:

```
{
  "channel": "zalo",
  "content": "Here's your image",
  "media": [\
    { "url": "/tmp/image.jpg", "type": "image" }\
  ]
}
```

### Pairing by Default

[Permalink: Pairing by Default](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#pairing-by-default)

Default DM policy is `"pairing"`. New users see pairing code instructions with 60-second debounce (no spam). Owner approves via:

```
/pair CODE
```

## Troubleshooting

[Permalink: Troubleshooting](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#troubleshooting)

| Issue | Solution |
| --- | --- |
| "Invalid API key" | Check token from Zalo OA console. Ensure OA is active and Bot API enabled. |
| No messages received | Verify polling is running (check logs). Ensure OA can accept messages (not suspended). |
| Image upload fails | Verify image file exists and is under `media_max_mb`. Check file format (JPG/PNG). |
| Webhook signature mismatch | Ensure `webhook_secret` matches Zalo console. Check timestamp is recent. |
| Pairing codes not sent | Check DM policy is `"pairing"`. Verify owner can send messages to OA. |

## What's Next

[Permalink: What's Next](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels/zalo-oa.md#whats-next)

- [Overview](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channels-overview) — Channel concepts and policies
- [Zalo Personal](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channel-zalo-personal) — Personal Zalo account integration
- [Telegram](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channel-telegram) — Telegram bot setup
- [Browser Pairing](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/goclaw-docs/blob/master/channel-browser-pairing) — Pairing flow

web.markdown:
Zalo For Developers [Nhảy tới nội dung](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367#docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback) Trên trang này # Gửi tin Tư vấn đính kèm file lưu ý để gửi thông báo đính kèm file, bạn cần sử dụng API upload file. ## HTTP request [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#http-request "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới HTTP request") - **URL:** [https://openapi.zalo.me/v3.0/oa/message/cs](https://openapi.zalo.me/v3.0/oa/message/cs) - **Method:** POST - **Content Type:** application/json - **Response Type:** text/json ## Example request [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#example-request "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Example request") ```bash curl \ -X POST \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H 'access_token: ' \ -d '{ "recipient": { "user_id": "2468458835296117922" }, "message": { "attachment": { "type": "file", "payload": { "token": "12i8LV3BcmmDS4iLfyoU3qKxHXNtpu077ZjA7xRHmmi8EXrEjuR50LHjJXJWWvTQ17OJ7R2Oc5q4SHSJjPoPKmDq5X2tyS4MI78oKexCna1CUJnQyiMvUKmfG7UOX8PYVW5FJAckbWbi1tWbj8BnCNOyTGMBr8mrG5XZ4epkfbD4HczzjUs3FM0QL1ZM" } } } }' "https://openapi.zalo.me/v3.0/oa/message/cs" ``` ### Tham số header [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#tham-s%E1%BB%91-header "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Tham số header") | **Tham số** | **Kiểu dữ liệu** | **Tính bắt buộc** | **Mô tả** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [access\_token](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/bat-dau/xac-thuc-va-uy-quyen-cho-ung-dung-new) | string | yes | Token cho phép ứng dụng đại diện OA gọi API. Xem chi tiết cách lấy access token [tại đây](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/bat-dau/xac-thuc-va-uy-quyen-cho-ung-dung-new). | ### Cấu trúc body của request [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#c%E1%BA%A5u-tr%C3%BAc-body-c%E1%BB%A7a-request "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Cấu trúc body của request") | **Tham số** | **Kiểu dữ liệu** | **Tính bắt buộc** | **Mô tả** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | recipient | object | yes | Thông tin người nhận | | message | object | yes | Nội dung cần gửi | ### Cấu trúc thuộc tính recipient [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#c%E1%BA%A5u-tr%C3%BAc-thu%E1%BB%99c-t%C3%ADnh-recipient "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Cấu trúc thuộc tính recipient") | **Tham số** | **Kiểu dữ liệu** | **Tính bắt buộc** | **Mô tả** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | user\_id | string | yes | ID của người nhận (nhận được thông qua API truy xuất chi tiết người dùng, API truy xuất danh sách người dùng). | ### Cấu trúc thuộc tính message [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#c%E1%BA%A5u-tr%C3%BAc-thu%E1%BB%99c-t%C3%ADnh-message "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Cấu trúc thuộc tính message") | **Tham số** | **Kiểu dữ liệu** | **Tính bắt buộc** | **Mô tả** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | attachment | object | yes | Attachment cần gửi | ### Cấu trúc thuộc tính message.attachment [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#c%E1%BA%A5u-tr%C3%BAc-thu%E1%BB%99c-t%C3%ADnh-messageattachment "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Cấu trúc thuộc tính message.attachment") | **Tham số** | **Loại** | **Tính bắt buộc** | **Mô tả** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | type | string | yes | Loại attachment
Giá trị nhận vào bắt buộc:
- `type` = **file** | | payload | object | yes | Chứa payload của attachment muốn gửi. Xem cấu trúc payload tại mục bên dưới. | ### Cấu trúc thuộc tính message.attachment.payload [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#c%E1%BA%A5u-tr%C3%BAc-thu%E1%BB%99c-t%C3%ADnh-messageattachmentpayload "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Cấu trúc thuộc tính message.attachment.payload") | **Tham số** | **Loại** | **Tính bắt buộc** | **Mô tả** | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | token | string | yes | Chuỗi token được trả về khi sử dụng API upload file. | ## Example respond [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#example-respond "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Example respond") #### 1\. Tin gửi ra là tin trong khung 48h [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#1-tin-g%E1%BB%ADi-ra-l%C3%A0-tin-trong-khung-48h "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới 1. Tin gửi ra là tin trong khung 48h") ```json { "data": { "quota": { "remain": "8", "total": "8" }, "message_id": "63ecf43f0df7dba892e6", "user_id": "2512523625412515", "sent_time": "1626926349402" }, "error": 0, "message": "Success" } ``` #### Cấu trúc thuộc tính data [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#c%E1%BA%A5u-tr%C3%BAc-thu%E1%BB%99c-t%C3%ADnh-data "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Cấu trúc thuộc tính data") | **Thuộc tính** | **Kiểu dữ liệu** | **Mô tả** | | --- | --- | --- | | message\_id | string | ID của thông báo | | user\_id | string | ID của người nhận | | quota\_type | string | Nguồn quota sử dụng
Mang giá trị: “reply” | | remain | string | Từ ngày 1/1/2026, đối tác có thể gửi tin Tư vấn miễn phí không giới hạn trong khung 48h
**Lộ trình chuyển đổi như sau:**
- Từ ngày 1/1/2026: luôn trả về giá trị remain = 8
- Sau ngày 1/3/2026: sẽ dừng trả về thuộc tính này | | total | string | Sau ngày 1/3/2026: sẽ dừng trả về thuộc tính này | | sent\_time | string | Thời gian gửi tin UID (định dạng timestamp). | #### 2\. Tin gửi đến User Quan tâm (khi chưa có tương tác) [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#2-tin-g%E1%BB%ADi-%C4%91%E1%BA%BFn-user-quan-t%C3%A2m-khi-ch%C6%B0a-c%C3%B3-t%C6%B0%C6%A1ng-t%C3%A1c "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới 2. Tin gửi đến User Quan tâm (khi chưa có tương tác)") ```json { "data": { "quota": { "quota_type": "welcome_msg", "remain": "2", "total": "3" }, "message_id": "63ecf43f0df7dba892e6", "user_id": "2512523625412515", "sent_time": "1626926349402" }, "error": 0, "message": "Success" } ``` #### Cấu trúc thuộc tính data [​](https://stc-developers.zdn.vn/docs/v2/official-account/tin-nhan/tin-tu-van/gui-tin-tu-van-dinh-kem-file?lang=vi&ts=1785208077367\#c%E1%BA%A5u-tr%C3%BAc-thu%E1%BB%99c-t%C3%ADnh-data-1 "Đường dẫn trực tiếp tới Cấu trúc thuộc tính data") | **Thuộc tính** | **Kiểu dữ liệu** | **Mô tả** | | --- | --- | --- | | message\_id | string | ID của thông báo | | user\_id | string | ID của người nhận | | quota\_type | string | Nguồn quota sử dụng

web.markdown:
For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/llms.txt). This page is also available as [Markdown](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa.md).

To integrate Zalo Official Account (OA) with XBot, businesses need to follow specific steps to ensure seamless communication between Zalo users and the bot. Here's a detailed guide on how to achieve this integration:

## Steps for Integrating Zalo OA with XBot[Direct link to heading](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa\#steps-for-integrating-zalo-oa-with-xbot)

### **1\. Register a Zalo OA Account**[Direct link to heading](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa\#id-1.-register-a-zalo-oa-account)

Ensure that your business has a registered OA account with a subscription to a paid plan. You can find more details on the plans here: [Zalo OA Pricing](https://zalo.cloud/oa/pricing).

### **2\. Create an App on Zalo**[Direct link to heading](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa\#id-2.-create-an-app-on-zalo)

- Navigate to the Zalo Developers site and create a new app.

- Follow the instructions to set up your app and obtain the necessary credentials.


### **3\. Verify Webhook Domain**[Direct link to heading](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa\#id-3.-verify-webhook-domain)

- Set up your webhook URL, which will be used to receive events from Zalo.

- Verify the domain of your webhook URL as per Zalo’s guidelines.


### **4\. Register to use API**[Direct link to heading](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa\#id-4.-register-to-use-api)

- Apply for the "User Management" API to get approval from Zalo for your OA account.

- This API will allow you to manage user interactions through your OA account.


### **5\. Link App with OA Account**[Direct link to heading](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa\#id-5.-link-app-with-oa-account)

- Connect your newly created app to your OA account by following the linking procedures in Zalo’s documentation.

- **Configure Webhook URL**:



  - Configure your webhook URL in the Zalo app settings.

  - This URL will be used by XBot to send event messages when users interact with your OA.


### **6\. Enable Necessary Events**[Direct link to heading](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa\#id-6.-enable-necessary-events)

- Ensure that the following events are enabled so that Zalo can send them to XBot:



  - `user_send_image`: Event when a user sends an image message.

  - `user_send_link`: Event when a user sends a link message.

  - `user_send_text`: Event when a user sends a text message.

  - `user_submit_info`: Event when a user shares information.

  - `user_send_file`: Event when a user sends a file attachment.


These events ensure that whenever users interact through the Zalo OA by sending messages, links, images, files, or sharing information, these are promptly sent to XBot for processing.

### **7\. Zalo Documentation**[Direct link to heading](https://docs.a4b.vn/xbot/features/communication-channels/zalo-oa\#id-7.-zalo-documentation)

- Refer to the Zalo documentation for detailed instructions on sending messages from OA: [Zalo Official Account Documentation](https://developers.zalo.me/docs/official-account/bat-dau/kham-pha).

web.title: Send Zalo message with attached photo | EN - eSMS for Developers
web.markdown:
For the complete documentation index, see [llms.txt](https://developers.esms.vn/llms.txt). This page is also available as [Markdown](https://developers.esms.vn/en/esms-api/send-sms-api/send-zalo-message-with-attached-photo.md).

## HTTP request[Direct link to heading](https://developers.esms.vn/en/esms-api/send-sms-api/send-zalo-message-with-attached-photo\#http-request)

`POST`[https://rest.esms.vn/MainService.svc/json/SendZaloFollowerMessage\_V5\_post\_json/](http://rest.esms.vn/MainService.svc/json/SendZaloFollowerMessage_V5_post_json/)

- **Content Type:** application/json

- **Response Type:** application/json


Copy

```
curl --location 'http://rest.esms.vn/MainService.svc/json/SendZaloFollowerMessage_V5_post_json/' \
--header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \
--header 'Cookie: ASP.NET_SessionId=asfgp2dj1kt4kbg1yzuo35ky; ASP.NET_SessionId=5xcbl12ska5q5wocug3chmjz' \
--data '{
    "ApiKey": "{{ApiKey}}",
    "SecretKey": "{{SecretKey}}",
    "OAID": "{{OAID}}",
    "CallbackUrl": "{{CallbackUrl}}",
    "RequestId": "{{RequestId}}",
    "Payload": {
        "recipient": {
            "user_id": "{{user_id}}"
        },
        "message": {
            "text": "{{text}}",
            "attachment": {
                "type": "template",
                "payload": {
                    "template_type": "media",
                    "elements": [\
                        {\
                            "media_type": "image",\
                            "url": "{{url}}"\
                        }\
                    ]
                }
            }
        }
    }
}'
```

- **Body request**


Required

Parameter

Type

Required

Description

ApiKey

string

Your API Key.

SecretKey

string

Your Secret Key.

OAID

string

Zalo OA Id is the Zalo Official Account Id of the organization. It can be obtained by accessing to the Zalo administrator page.

**Note: Pre-registration is required.**

user\_id

string

The identification value of user at Zalo.

text

string

Text content to send to users Maximum limit is 2,000 characters

url

string

Image path

Supported image formats: jpg and png Maximum size: 1MB

RequestId

string

Partner ID passed to block duplicates and check if needed.
Maximum length 50 characters.
Each RequestId passed is valid for blocking for 24 hours.

CallbackUrl

string

The webhook URL that will receive the status of message after it processed to the operator. It is used for determine whether the SMS is succcessfully delivered to the receiver or failed.
See the sample request at [here](https://samplefordevelopers.esms.vn/#20f85e1f-3d9e-4ff4-bc4f-8d9c9edbc88a).
More details at [here](https://developers.esms.vn/en/esms-api/callback-url).

* * *

- **Response:**


100

101

Copy

```
{
    "CodeResult": "100",
    "CountRegenerate": 0,
    "SMSID": "d8e0f1f0702544b2acb456ca9ccfd111250"
}
```

**Valid request.**

Copy

```
{
    "CodeResult": "101",
    "CountRegenerate": 0,
    "ErrorMessage": "Authorize Failed"
}
```

**Invalid credential.**

- **Response body**


Parameter

Type

Description

CodeResult

string

Response code.

SMSID

string

The message id eSMS system.

ErrorMessage

string

The error message if the request is invalid.

- _**The detail of error code can refer at**_ [**Table of error codes**](https://developers.esms.vn/en/esms-api/table-of-error-codes) **.**

- _**Get the sample of code for programing languagues to use in Postman refer at**_ [**Link of code samples**](https://samplefordevelopers.esms.vn/#850974b9-12cf-46f5-946c-e8e15aa3585b) **.**
